findings.title: Optimized paginator cannot paginate datetime fields
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint uses this paginator with `order_by="-datetime"`, but this implementation treats the sort key as a number. On any non-empty page, `build_cursor` calls `get_item_key` with a `datetime`, and `math.floor(datetime)` raises `TypeError`, so requests with optimized pagination enabled fail. Its `value_from_cursor` also returns the raw numeric cursor value rather than converting it to a datetime, which would make subsequent-page filters incompatible with the datetime column.

findings.title: Negative cursor offsets cause a Django pagination error
findings.body: A caller can supply a cursor with a negative offset, and this branch passes that value into a QuerySet slice. Django does not support negative QuerySet indexing and raises `ValueError` for a negative slice start, turning the request into a server error rather than providing the claimed reverse-pagination behavior.
